title: ElytraTweaks
description: A mod that allows to change the keybind that serves to open (and close) the elytras. Idea from : @VaffanClash on discord
body:
A mod that allows to change the keybind that serves to open (and close) the elytras. Idea from : @VaffanClash on discord
Instead of using the jump key, use the 'left-alt' key to open your elytra.
You can now also close it midair !
